messages:
Alex (AE): Heads-up — ACME legal + infra signed NDAs, they're asking if we can run a short on‑prem air‑gapped POC next month. Key asks: signed bundle delivery, upgrade cadence (they want strict windows), and cost delta for reserved capacity. Can ops/eng confirm feasibility?
Maya (SE): @Alex good call. High level: we can do an airgapped POC. We provide a signed tarball + SBOM and an installer. Need to confirm max bundle size for their jumpbox (they said 8GB available).
Sam (Infra Eng): 8GB is tight if we deliver full model weights. Options: (1) quantized model bundle (~900MB for our 7B quantized snapshot), (2) model-on-demand split (core runtime + separate model artifact chunks), or (3) streamed pull via secure sidechannel (but that breaks airgap).
Jordan (Solutions): They explicitly forbade external egress during install, so no streaming. Let's propose (2) chunked artifacts + USB transfer (sneakernet) and signed manifests. They also want a 6 month upgrade freeze window for the initial pilot.
Maya (SE): Upgrade cadence note: our supported offline upgrade cadence is typically quarterly patches + emergency hotfixes. We can do a 6‑month freeze for pilot but need an exception: security hotfixes will still be allowed with signed delta bundles.
Alex (AE): Pricing question from buyer — what’s the delta vs hosted? They asked per‑month reserved pricing for dedicated GPU pool in an airgapped site and one‑time packaging/signing fee.
Sam (Infra Eng): Pricing inputs: reserved capacity + one‑time onprem packaging + dedicated SRE support. Rough ballpark: reserved commit equivalent to 2x vCPU/GPU nodes -> I'll DM finance for exact figure, but packaging/signing engineering setup is a one‑time $12k engagement (includes SBOM, code sign, and test harness).
Jordan (Solutions): Also clarify HSM/KMS: they require customer-controlled keys for model sealing. We support customer KMS workflow: we ship bundle signed by us, customer re‑signs with their HSM as part of installation. Need ops runbook for key injection.
Maya (SE): Ops runbook snippet for the install (paste):
```
1) Bring bundle.tar.gz -> verify signature: `cosign verify --key customer.pub bundle.tar.gz`
2) Verify SBOM: `syft sbom.json`
3) Run installer: `./redwood-install --airgap --model-dir /opt/redwood/models`
4) Post-install smoke: `curl --unix:/var/run/redwood.sock /healthz`
```
Sam (Infra Eng): We'll add the HSM step between 1 and 2. Also note: for delta upgrades we support chunked diffs signed with the same key. Diffing reduces transfer to <200MB typically.
Alex (AE): Legal/security asked about attestation and provenance — they want chain-of-custody doc. Can security produce short blurb we can attach to SOW?
security-bot: Security checklist ready. We provide: signed artifact, SBOM (CycloneDX), SHA256 manifest, reproducible-build statement, and acceptance testing checklist. Will also generate a short PoC attestation PDF.
Jordan (Solutions): Two blockers ACME raised: (A) offline telemetry — they require zero telemetry exfil by default, (B) patch policy — they want no auto‑update and a manual approval gate. Can we meet both?
Maya (SE): (A) default is telemetry off in airgapped builds. We ship with telemetry disabled and a local metrics endpoint for customer only. (B) manual update approvals supported via the Console offline workflow — we provide signed deltas and a manual apply script.
Alex (AE): Great. Next steps: I'll send a short SOW draft with pricing placeholder, include the packaging fee + reserved capacity line, attach security-bot artifacts, and propose install window options (weekend or weeknight). Any strong objections? :thumbsup:
Sam (Infra Eng): No objections. Will prepare a small test artifact (quantized 7B) for transfer and verify install in lab by EOD Friday.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll create a short runbook + acceptance criteria doc and link it in the SOW.
Maya (SE): I'll patch the installer to add a `--require-local-signature` flag for customer HSM flows and run the smoke tests.
Alex (AE): Thanks team — I'll update ACME and loop legal. If we get LOI this week we can lock dates.
security-bot: Attached: /artifacts/attestation-acme-template.pdf (internal).
Alex (AE): @security-bot got it — will attach to email.
Jordan (Solutions): Small follow-up: ACME asked whether we can guarantee no model weights leave the site after install. Confirmable?
Sam (Infra Eng): Yes — with telemetry off and network egress blocked we have no outbound model sync. We can add a local-only enforcement check in installer to fail if any external route is detected.
Alex (AE): Perfect. I'll set a meeting with ACME for Wed to review SOW. Thanks everyone.
